title: Analytics pipeline segmentation and cross-border fallbacks
creator: Marcus Liu
description:
Goal: Implement per-tenant analytics segmentation so usage events emitted by the Console backend are stored and queried in region-local pipelines when required by customer policy, while providing robust, auditable cross-border fallback behavior for capacity and recovery scenarios. This ticket covers design and initial implementation of a routing & gating layer in the ingestion path, plus replication controls to ensure legal controls (data residency, GDPR/Schrems-II, SOC) are enforced without blocking high-availability telemetry flows.

Key problems to solve:
- Determine authoritative tenant residency metadata and enforce it at the ingestion gateway and pipeline router.
- Implement a fanout strategy that writes events to local regional sinks and async-replicates to allowed downstream analytics clusters where permitted.
- Provide controlled fallback paths for write availability when a regional sink is degraded (e.g., transient outage, capacity pressure) while recording policy decisions for audit and later reconciliation.
- Ensure encryption-in-flight and KMS usage for cross-region transfers, and enable tenant-level opt-in/opt-out controls surfaced in Console.
- Add observability: per-tenant metrics (ingest latency, replication lag), audit logs for policy overrides, and SLO alerts for regional availability and replication constraints.

Non-goals for this ticket: complete UI for tenancy residency management (handled in PM follow-ups), full on-prem private deployment replication (covered separately under Private deployment roadmap).
acceptance_criteria: Ingress gateway tags each event with tenant residency metadata and a signed policy decision header
Events are routed to the tenant's preferred regional sink when residency policy == regional and that sink is healthy
If regional sink is unhealthy, system transparently routes to a pre-approved fallback (cross-region) when policy permits and records an auditable override entry
Replication channels to secondary regions use TLS + customer/KMS-wrapped keys and are logged with request IDs for traceability
Dashboard shows per-tenant ingest success/fallback rates and replication lag; alert fires when fallback rate > 1% for a tenant for 5 minutes
Automated canary (synthetic) traffic verifies routing decisions for 3 representative tenant profiles before rollout
Integration tests cover: healthy regional path, regional outage -> fallback path, policy block -> drop-with-audit
E2E latency impact on p50 ingest < 15ms and p95 < 60ms for local regional writes under typical load profile
tasks: Design: finalize routing/gating state machine and policy schema (edges: ALLOW_LOCAL, ALLOW_CROSS, BLOCK, FALLBACK_IF_CAPACITY)
Infra: add residency lookup cache to ingestion gateway with TTL and stale-handling rules
Pipeline: implement regional sink plugin interface and fallback connector for cross-region replication
Security: integrate cross-region transfer with KMS-wrapped keys and update key rotation docs
Observability: emit new metrics and audit events; add console dashboard mockups for PM review
Tests: unit + integration harness; synthetic canary traffic job
Rollout: staged canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with rollback hooks and throttles
comments: 2025-03-18 Marcus Liu: Kicked off initial design spike. Spent time mapping current console ingest path and where tenant metadata is attached. Found gaps: some internal services inject events without tenant headers — we need to standardize the header contract.

2025-03-19 Aisha Banerjee: Design proposal uploaded to Confluence (link below). Decided to favour eventual consistency for cross-region replication to avoid blocking writes during regional outages; we will surface overrides in audit logs and provide an API to reconcile later.

2025-03-20 Priya Shah (Security): Reviewed encryption proposal. Cross-region transfer must use customer KMS integration where enabled; fallback writes will use envelope encryption with auditable key IDs. Security raised a question about key-granularity per-tenant — marking security_review_required.

2025-03-21 Marcus Liu: Implemented residency cache prototype in gateway; cache miss path calls tenancy service and sets TTL=5m. Observed p50 added <2ms in local dev; need to load-test under burst traffic. Creating sub-issues for load testing and schema evolution.

2025-03-22 Aisha Banerjee: Agreed on acceptance criteria and rollout plan with PM. Preparing canary harness and SLO thresholds. Scheduling a sync with support to surface customer opt-in controls in the Console later.
